drivingQuestion: Is the halakha in accordance with R' Yehuda's distinct blessing over herbs, and what is his reason?
outcomeNote: The halakha is ruled not to follow R' Yehuda, and his reason is explained from Psalms 68:20

segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר ״בּוֹרֵא מִינֵי דְשָׁאִים״. אָמַר רַבִּי זֵירָא, וְאִיתֵּימָא רַבִּי חִינָּנָא בַּר פָּפָּא: אֵין הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה. וְאָמַר רַבִּי זֵירָא וְאִיתֵּימָא רַבִּי חִינָּנָא בַּר פָּפָּא: מַאי טַעְמָא דְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה — אָמַר קְרָא ״בָּרוּךְ ה׳ יוֹם יוֹם״. וְכִי בַּיּוֹם מְבָרְכִין אוֹתוֹ, וּבַלַּיְלָה אֵין מְבָרְכִין אוֹתוֹ? אֶלָּא לוֹמַר לָךְ: כׇּל יוֹם וָיוֹם תֵּן לוֹ מֵעֵין בִּרְכוֹתָיו, הָכָא נָמֵי כׇּל מִין וּמִין תֵּן לוֹ מֵעֵין בִּרְכוֹתָיו.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that «Rabbi Yehuda says» that one recites over herbs and leafy greens: «Who creates various kinds of herbs. Rabbi Zeira, and some say Rabbi Ḥinnana bar Pappa, said: The halakha is not in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Yehuda. And Rabbi Zeira, and some say Rabbi Ḥinnana bar Pappa, said: What is the reason for Rabbi Yehuda’s» opinion? «The verse says: “Blessed is the Lord, day by day”» (Psalms 68:20). The question arises: «Is it so that one blesses Him by day and does not bless Him at night? Rather,» the verse comes «to tell you: Each and every day, give the Lord» the appropriate «blessings» for that day. «Here too,» with regard to the blessings recited over food, for «each and every type» of food, «give the» Lord the appropriate blessings for that food.

moves.about: the halakha does not follow R' Yehuda's distinct blessing over herbs

moves.summary: R' Zeira (or R' Chinnana bar Pappa) asks R' Yehuda's reason
moves.about: why R' Yehuda requires a distinct blessing over herbs

moves.summary: The verse 'Blessed is the Lord day by day' is adduced as R' Yehuda's source
moves.about: the verse 'Blessed is the Lord, day by day' as the source of R' Yehuda's view

moves.summary: Rhetorical difficulty: is God blessed by day and not by night?
moves.about: 'day by day' cannot mean God is blessed only by day; it teaches that each day receives its own fitting blessings

moves.summary: Rather: each day gets its own fitting blessings; so too each kind of food gets its own blessing
moves.about: R' Yehuda's distinct blessing for herbs rests on the principle that each kind receives its own fitting blessing, derived from Psalms 68:20
